segments.text: The protagonist of the rēve parfait games.

Rio is Reon and Aki's childhood friend. She is a serious girl who works as her class' president. During the summer of her second year in middle school, she began dating Reon but broke up due to a certain reason. From then on, Rio hasn't ever fallen in love again.
Translation of official website character profile.
Reon is the vocalist of rēve parfait.

Though he's arrogant, selfish, overbearing and only does things his own way, Reon also has a childish side to him. He can also be moody and highly strung; his emotions having extreme highs and lows. Invited by his older brother Aki, Reon joined the band. When he's in the middle of composing, he gets so absorbed that he forgets about the world around him.
Translation of official website character profile.
Tsumugi is the bassist of rēve parfait.

Tsumugi quickly resorts to fighting and has a sharp tongue, but he has a straightforward personality and says what he thinks. Initially belonging to a different band, Reon invited and recruited Tsumugi after having been charmed by the latter's skill as a bassist. With Tsumugi joining, rēve parfait was formed. His deceased elder brother Momose Hiroto inspired Tsumugi to start playing the bass guitar.
Translation of official website character profile.
Kuon is the lead guitarist of rēve parfait.

As the leader of rēve parfait, Kuon always takes the wishes of his bandmates into consideration. Very caring and a good conversationalist, he has a lot of friends. Since his father is a congressman and his mother is a lawyer, Kuon is polite and gets excellent grades. Since his parents are often away on business, the Tsukinohara family's house has become the band's hangout.
Translation of official website character profile.
Aki is the drummer of rēve parfait.

Reon's older brother, Aki is gentle and carefree. He doesn't have much confidence in himself and gets anxious easily. When Aki was in his 3rd year of middle school, he invited his best friend Kuon and his younger brother Reon, which lead towards the formation of rēve parfait. He chose to become the band's drummer because he wishes to act as musical support for Reon and Kuon. Aki is also the lyricist, and his unique outlook of the world is part of the band's style.
Translation of official website character profile.
The manager of rēve parfait.

Yakumo has been working for music company DYNAMIC CHORD within its management division for three years. He is tasked with managing rēve parfait, who have been newly represented by the company. Yakumo has a gentle disposition, and is hardworking and enthusiastic about his job. He tends to get too caught up in his career.
Translation of official website character profile.

Kanako is a groupie that loves bands and lives for chasing them. While she is a compassionate and cheerful person, her passionate personality brings out a side of her that goes on the offensive when somebody gets their hands on something or someone she likes. She is good at hairstyling and doing make-up.
Translation of official website character profile.

She loves to have fun and has a lively disposition, but is actually pure-hearted and has a complex about her complete lack of experience with love. Completely devoted to chasing bands as a groupie, Ayu has a wide and extensive knowledge of them, both indie and commerical. She is good at doing make-up.
Translation of official website character profile.

Rio's mother. Since her husband passed away due to an illness, Mao became a single mother; raising Rio on her own whilst working as a nurse. She has a cheerful and composed personality, but is strong-willed. She has known the Kashii family for a long time.
Translation of official website character profile.
Reon and Aki's father. He's an honest and serious man but is tactless and taciturn. Never remarrying after his divorce, he's remained unmarried. Reon took after Shuuyou and Aki took after his mother.
Translation of official website character profile.

Tsumugi's stepsister. After Yuri married Tsumugi's elder brother Hiroto and had Takuto with him, Hiroto passed away. Even after Hiroto's passing, Yuri continues to live with the Momose family. Determined and unyielding, she often fights with Tsumugi as though they were real siblings.
Translation of official website character profile.
Tsumugi's nephew. He is a very energetic boy with a habit of saying "nano". Tsumugi dotes on him.
Translation of official website character profile.

Tsumugi's elder brother who had passed away a few years ago. He was arrogant, proud, overbearing and straightforward. Hiroto wasn't bound by anything and lived freely. He was a bassist in the band he was a member of, but readily quit when he got married.
Translation of official website character profile.

Kuon's younger sister. Their parents decided that Haruka attend a boarding middle school, so she only comes back home during the holidays. Kuon treasures Haruka, and Haruka adores Kuon. She secretly harbours feelings for Aki.
Translation of official website character profile.
The managing director of the record label DYNAMIC CHORD. His slogan is "tenacity" and he's a skilled boss. Since his eyesight is extremely bad, Hisaomi always has his glasses on.
Translation of official website character profile.

Jin is the owner of the live music club "VIVIANTE". Clear-minded and light-hearted. With his pirate-like character, he becomes friends with others easily. He dislikes being called "Owner" and insists on being called by his nickname, "Jin". His real name is Tatekawa Jinhei.
Translation of official website character profile.
A girl who dated Kuon during their middle school days.
Translation of official website character profile.
Apple Polisher's vocalist. A vocal with clear singing voice.
Although he spent much time abroad, his speech is clear. He is also a straight personality and the youngest in the band. Narumi often writes lyrics for the songs apple-polisher.
Makes an appearence in Dynamic Chord feat. rēve parfait as Rio's childhood friend.
He is a bit cynical and love tobacco and sake.

He fell in love with NaL's singing voice and invited NaL to the band and created apple-polisher. He is good at makeing dance-able music which is becoming the personality of apple-polisher, and is in charge of composition and lyrics.
The bassist and leader of the apple-polisher. Calm and collected personality. Yuki's childhood friend. In the past he was writing songwriting, but for some reason now have not done it.
